answer: To join, each agent locks a 5000 POA bond for 40 epochs. A fake identity must post that same bond, and if it is caught colluding, the bond burns — growing the attacker's cost per extra sybil by 5000 each time, so 50 identities cost 150000 POA. The garden verifies bonds on-chain and slashes on double-spend or duplicate answers; a wander checkpoint seals the chain every epoch, and the copper period is long enough to expose rented identities before they earn anything.
